title: First Cafe Opens at Tokyo's Imperial Palace
paragraphs: The Imperial Palace in Tokyo is a very famous place. Now, visitors can drink coffee there too.

On November 3, 2026, a new building opened in the Imperial Palace East Gardens. It is called the Ote Rest House. Inside, there is a cafe from Sarutahiko Coffee, a popular coffee company in Japan. According to a news report, it is the first time a cafe has opened inside the Imperial Palace grounds.
The cafe has a special coffee that people can only buy there. It is called the East Gardens blend. There are two kinds, light and dark. The cafe has 46 seats and space for 10 people to stand.

The Ote Rest House is also a visitor center. It has a shop that sells souvenirs. For example, there are bags of coffee with pictures of famous art on them. Five bags cost 1,400 yen. The building also has information about the imperial family, the palace and places to visit around Japan. There are big screens that show pictures of different parts of Japan. On the roof, there is a deck where people can look at the palace gardens.
On the same day, a museum across from the Ote Rest House opened again. It shows art from the imperial family's collection.
It is free to visit the East Gardens. The Ote Rest House is usually open at the same times as the gardens.
